title: Adic completeness and classical reductions of qcqs finite-model integral inputs
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_F$ and uniformizer $\pi$, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme $V$. Give $A$ its induced $\ell$-adic norm topology, put $A_V=p_V^*\underline A$ and $P_{n,V}=(A/\pi^n)_V$, and work in the ordinary unbounded derived module-object category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], with the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. If $J\in\mathrm D_{\mathrm{ctf}}(V,A)$ for the finite constant scalar-model definition [sk-def-sfb-constructible], then $J$ is derived $\pi$-complete [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]: its canonical strict-tower completion unit $J\to R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n(J\otimes^L_{A_V}P_{n,V})$ is an isomorphism. For every $n\ge1$, its derived reduction $J_n=J\otimes^L_{A_V}P_{n,V}$ is bounded and constructible and has an étale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness] after the finite discrete coefficient equivalence [lem-sf-module-object-ordinary-coefficient-equivalence]. There is no Noetherian, characteristic, dimension or invertibility-of-$\ell$ hypothesis on $V$.

proof.text: Choose the defining finite constructible stratification and pro-etale covers of each cohomology sheaf. Apply finite_strata_completion_detection to the same partition, forgetting only its constructibility field in the finite-locally-closed record. Exact inverse image commutes with single objects. The supplied local model isomorphisms and the scalar-module clause of finite_scalar_local_model_complete show that every covering restriction of a constructible sheaf placed in degree zero is complete, so detection proves its completeness.

Use completion_triangle_comparison to express completeness as invertibility of the specified natural unit. Naturality gives invariance under isomorphism. Its shift equation gives shift closure. The morphism of distinguished triangles gives extension closure by the triangle-morphism isomorphism criterion, and additivity gives the zero case. Apply the already-proved generic DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded truncation theorem to bounded J and its complete cohomology sheaves. Thus its actual strict-tower completion unit is invertible.

Fix n indexing the positive exponent n+1. finite_model_sheaf_quotient_constructible supplies quotient finiteness and discreteness and internal bounded constructibility for each reduced integral constructible sheaf. Choose a normalized Encoding. encoding_constructibility identifies internal and ordinary finite scalar models. Use the existing private ordinary_constructible_iff theorem in LocalizingClosureCtfEqualsBc, accessed through a proof-only import all, to identify ordinaryConstructible with the source fixed-module IsConstructible predicate. Its existing ordinary_localModel_iff helper handles cover-index universe lifting and smallness; neither comparison is reproved here. The fixed-module constructible-origin theorem gives constructible etale antecedents for the homology sheaves, and boundedConstructible_of_homology gives bounded etale origin for each reduced sheaf.

Equip the actual derived quotient extension with the triangulated structure obtained from its adjunction to exact restriction. Compose with the normalized encoding. The source fixed-module bounded-constructible etale-origin subcategory is triangulated; inverse image of this property under the composite is triangulated. Apply DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded to J and the reduced degree-zero sheaves of the preceding step. The result has bounded constructible intrinsic cohomology. Transport back along encoding_constructibility for internal constructibility. Retain its bounded etale antecedent, regarded as bounded below, and the supplied comparison isomorphism as FixedEtaleOriginWitness.
